ops.text: (c) Indemnification by HDI. HDI shall defend and indemnify the Company and its affiliates from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting damages, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees), to the extent arising out of (1) an allegation that the Services or any deliverables provided by HDI, including the Site, infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right; (2) HDI's breach of applicable law; (3) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Company data caused by HDI; or (4) HDI's gross negligence or wilful misconduct. The Company shall give HDI prompt written notice of the claim, HDI shall have control of the defense, and the Company shall provide reasonable cooperation.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added an HDI indemnity as new Section 9(c) because the Agreement currently contains no indemnity or defence obligation in either direction, covering third-party IP claims relating to the Services and deliverables (including the Site), HDI's breach of law, HDI-caused unauthorized disclosure of Company data, and HDI's gross negligence or wilful misconduct, with notice, control and cooperation only. We have dropped the hold-harmless wording and the settlement-consent proviso to keep the clause to our standard defend-and-indemnify position.
proposal.summary: Insert HDI defend-and-indemnify clause (IP infringement, breach of law, HDI-caused data breach, gross negligence/wilful misconduct) with notice, control and cooperation as new Section 9(c)
